messages.subject: Project Aquilo - technical specification (Schedule 1)
messages.plaintextBody:
Martin,

Could you sanity-check the technical specification schedule before it goes to Calderwater's engineers? In particular the duty points for the HX-300 (260 l/s @ 22m) and the SCADA/Modbus TCP interface on the control panels. I want to be sure we're not warranting anything we can't meet.

Thanks,

Elena Marchetti
Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
T +44 (0)20 7946 0048
whitfieldcarter.com

messages.subject: RE: Project Aquilo - technical specification (Schedule 1)
messages.plaintextBody:
Elena,

Duty points are fine and conservative. Two tweaks: the SX-250 should be a channel impeller (not vortex) for their grit loading, and please make the FAT witness notice 10 business days not 5 - our test bay schedule is tight. Otherwise good to go.

Martin
